overview.description: The State Street Fixed Income Sector Rotation ETF (FISR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively-managed portfolio of fixed income ETFs classified within favorable sectors. FISR was launched on Apr 2, 2019 and is issued by State Street.
